thread:
Priya: Quick alert 5min ago5 - promo code PROMO50 appears to have been applied twice for some cohort-A customers after we swapped price_ids for the A/B experiment. Example: INV-9612 shows 50% then another 50% line, netting 75% off instead of intended single 50%.
Leo: Wow. That would underbill us. Which customers and how many invoices?
Priya: Initial scan: 5 invoices in last 24h; biggest affected invoice INV-9612 (expected due $400, billed $100).
Kara: How did that happen? Promo codes are supposed to be keyed to customer_id + promo_id. Did price_id reuse cause promo to re-evaluate?
Amir: Looking at the rollout notes, we reused price_id price_experiment_A for cohort-A but kept legacy promo mapping that keyed on price_id. The reconciliation logic dedupes promos by (customer, price_id, invoice_ts), but because we created a brand-new invoice item and then swapped price_id mid-cycle the dedupe missed the previous promo tag.
Priya: So bug is dedupe key should include the original price_token or promo_run_id, not just price_id.
Leo: Customers have already written in asking why invoices are low. We need to fix ledger and send corrected invoices if appropriate. Policy: underbilling that reduces expected revenue > $500 needs controller sign-off to reissue corrected invoice.
Kara: Total underbilled exposure across 5 invoices is ~$1,200. That crosses threshold. @FinanceController can you approve reissue and adjustment path?
FinanceController: Approve controller review. Given this is a system dedupe bug caused by price_id reuse, I authorize corrections but want writeup and customer note before reissue. Tag FIN-2600 for audit.
Priya: Proposed remediation plan:
1) Create reversing invoice entries to remove the extra promo line for the five affected invoices and recalc to expected amounts.
2) If customers already paid the lower amount, generate an invoice-correction note and a gentle collection path (notify sales for any enterprise customers).
3) Push a hotfix to dedupe logic to include promo_run_id.
4) Update rollout checklist to never reuse price_id across experiments.
Commands I'll run in dry-run first:
```
# list affected invoices
billing-cli invoices search --query "promo:PROMO50 AND created>2026-04-12" --output json
# dry-run reconcile removing duplicate promo line from INV-9612
billing-cli invoices reconcile --invoice INV-9612 --remove-duplicate-promo --dry-run
# create reversing lines (dry-run)
billing-cli invoices adjust --invoice INV-9612 --add-line "promo_reversal" --amount 300 --dry-run
```
Leo: Hold for 1h so Sales can review enterprise list and we can draft customer comms.
Amir: I'll queue a worker to scan historical invoices for any other duplicate-promo cases due to reused price_ids and output a report.
BillingBot: INV-9612 generated 2026-04-12 19:02 UTC. Status: paid. Note: dry-run commands do not modify ledger. Ensure FIN-2600 ticket is attached to any applied corrections.
Kara: After hotfix, add a migration job to reconcile promos for last 30 days. Also add a safety assert to the manifest uploader that fails if price_id already exists.
Priya: Thanks everyone. I'll post customer message drafts here and wait for FinanceController to sign off the corrections. :white_check_mark:
FinanceController: Once corrections applied, provide a short postmortem (root cause + mitigation + timeline). Approved to proceed after comms reviewed.
